I was/am the moderator over on reddit and decided voat.co needed a subverse for our great beer community. Post pictures of your hauls, discuss upcoming or past events, ask for trades, or anything else you want that's related to beer.

Question-- Why can I no longer find Boulevard Pale Ale in Dallas? Maybe no one knows. I am really bumming though. Summit EPA (my hometown brew) seems to have stopped distributing down here the same week. There is some conspiracy going on, I swear. -_-

I'm not sure, maybe it's a store thing? Like it wasn't selling that well in Dallas. I would ask your store if they can still get their hands on it and ask them to bring it in if they can. Boulevard distributes to Texas so they should be able to get it. It's the beer they started with back in 1989, so I can't imagine they wouldn't distribute it with their other beers. Do you still get Wheat and other Boulevard beers?

Like with Summit, there are still some flavors still on the shelf. I know Summit quit distributing and my order requests for Boulevard Pale Ale just aren't being filled. Thought there may be a link. Such a good brew and such a bummer lately. (The beer locator will still show it on shelves but like with Summit it is due to inventory discrepancies)
